verdict.rationale: Brex has a documented public developer API with authentication via API tokens/scopes, multiple OpenAPI-documented resources (transactions, budgets, expenses, users), webhooks for event-driven integration, and an llms.txt discovery file confirming the API's presence for programmatic/AI-native use. Missing for 10: a live discoverable OpenAPI spec (candidate paths 404'd) and independent third-party corroboration of API usage beyond vendor docs.
